facts.fact: The fourth session of the Algerian-Tunisian Joint Technical Commission on communications and ICT cooperation, held in Tunisia, concluded with agreement on joint projects on connectivity, postal and telecom modernisation and innovation; the report gives no meeting date, so its publication date of 2026-06-09 is used.

systems.country_label: Algerian-Tunisian Joint Technical Commission on communications and ICT cooperation

note: No effect fact: agreed projects are a statement of intent, with no start or use reported.
